name: Catlett Data Center Campus
developer_label: Headwaters Site Development LLC / Catlett Station II LLC
summary: The applicant withdrew a rezoning for a large data-center campus after organized opposition. Later warehouse preapplication activity means the site should be tracked as redesigned, not treated as permanently undeveloped.
proposal_description: Headwaters Site Development sought to rezone 68.27 acres in the Catlett Service District for a multi-building data-center campus, aboveground water storage, a substation, and a nearly three-mile transmission connection.

proposed_scale.label: Proposed campus
proposed_scale.value: Up to approximately 1.4 million square feet

proposed_scale.label: Rezoning area
proposed_scale.value: 68.27 acres, with proffers covering approximately 80 acres

proposed_scale.label: Concept alternatives
proposed_scale.value: Three campus options with proposed building heights of 45 to 65 feet

site_afterlife: Fauquier reporting identifies later preapplication material for a non-distributing warehouse concept. The site is therefore classified as redesigned rather than a clean no-development outcome.
evidence_note: The official record verifies withdrawal. Advocacy reporting supports a contributing community role, while the exact causal weight of opposition versus applicant economics remains unquantified.
unresolved_questions: Did the applicant sell, retain, or redesign every parcel covered by the withdrawn applications?
What is the relationship between the data-center parcels, the later warehouse concept, and the 2026 Catlett Farm federal review?
What electrical interconnection work, if any, continued after withdrawal?
What fiscal-impact analysis exists outside the county land-use file?

timeline.title: Rezoning enters county review
timeline.summary: County materials describe requests for a data-center campus and water-storage exception in the Catlett Service District.

timeline.title: Planning Commission receives a project update
timeline.summary: Commission minutes record a work-session update while staff and the applicant continued reviewing the campus concept.

timeline.title: Community group files detailed objections
timeline.summary: Citizens for Fauquier County published objections involving land-use policy, historic resources, noise, water, power infrastructure, and community compatibility.

timeline.title: Applicant withdraws both applications
timeline.summary: The official agenda request records withdrawal of REZN-23-020206 and SPEX-23-020207 before the scheduled hearing.

timeline.title: Warehouse concept appears in preapplication material
timeline.summary: A later non-distributing warehouse concept indicates potential redesign of the site rather than a stable untreated parcel.

timeline.title: Federal notice documents later Catlett Farm industrial activity
timeline.summary: A U.S. Army Corps public notice describes three proposed warehouses, wetland and stream impacts, and adverse effects on historic properties. It directly identifies Catlett Station II LLC but does not prove that every parcel matches the withdrawn campus boundary.

county_outcome_context.note: The county panel ends in 2024, the decision year, so it contains no full post-withdrawal year. Fauquier's 2024 values are context only; the site also has later industrial activity, preventing a simple untreated-county interpretation.
